findings.explanation: In S/4HANA neither ACDOCA nor ACDOCP has a CO `VERSN` field. ACDOCA holds actuals, and ACDOCP stores plan data by plan `CATEGORY` (e.g. PLN, with ACT01 mapped to legacy version 0). A SQL projection selecting `VERSN` will fail, and the SPL's `VERSN` filters will drop every row. detailedImplementation Step 1 repeats the claim.
findings.quote: `dbx:sap_acdoca` (universal journal actuals — ... `VERSN` = `000` for posted actuals ...) and `dbx:sap_acdocp` (plan versions in `VERSN` such as `100` AOP / `101`–`104` quarterly rolling forecast
findings.suggested_fix: Describe actuals as ACDOCA rows for the leading ledger (`RLDNR`) and plan rows as ACDOCP filtered by `CATEGORY`. Tell the reader to map the AOP and forecast categories to a `plan_version` column in SQL. Note that classic COSP/COSS `VERSN` applies only to ECC.

findings.explanation: Splunkbase app 4045 is 'Angular Examples', a dashboard example app, not an SAP HANA add-on. The same wrong ID appears in references. Readers following the link install the wrong app.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the 4045 reference. If HANA diagnostics are needed, cite a verified Splunkbase listing or just DB Connect with the HANA JDBC driver.

findings.explanation: BSTAT is the document status (blank = normal, A = clearing document, V = parked, M = sample, and so on), not a clearing status. The SPL's `BSTAT!="A"` therefore excludes clearing documents rather than 'statistical' or uncleared items, and the prose does not explain why.
findings.suggested_fix: Call it 'document status (BSTAT)' and say which statuses the SQL should exclude (e.g. parked V/W, sample M) and why clearing docs (A) are dropped.

findings.explanation: In S/4HANA, classic KP06 planning writes to legacy CO totals, not ACDOCP, unless the plan is configured to write to ACDOCP. 'KP56' does not appear to be a standard planning transaction, and 'KSEN/KSEU' and 'MEC1' in the troubleshooting section also look doubtful.
findings.quote: quarterly forecasts one-o-one through one-o-four when KP06/KP46/KP56 planners publish those slices
findings.suggested_fix: Check which planning tools populate ACDOCP in the target release (SAP Analytics Cloud, Fiori Plan Cost Centers, or KP06 with ACDOCP integration). Fix or remove the unverified transaction codes.

findings.explanation: The SPL window is fixed to the previous full month (`earliest=-1mon@mon latest=@mon`), so running it daily repeats last month and never shows month-to-date drift. detailedImplementation also stamps `_time` from 'ERP extraction timestamps', so the `_time` window will not line up with fiscal `GJAHR`/`POPER`. A once-a-year plan load would fall outside it entirely.
findings.quote: schedule this SPL daily once intraday postings settle
findings.suggested_fix: Say that `_time` must be set from the posting date / fiscal period, or filter on `GJAHR`/`POPER` instead of `_time`. Align the schedule text with the window (monthly after close, or a month-to-date variant).

findings.explanation: The SPL covers a single month, so the three-month and year-to-date panels need differently scoped searches or a summary index that the UC does not describe.
findings.quote: Trend chart of rolling three-month sum of signed variance ... Area chart of year-to-date cumulative actual versus plan per `dept`
findings.suggested_fix: Say that the trend and YTD panels read from a monthly summary index populated by this search.

findings.explanation: The UC is marked verified by an authoring agent, yet its core table fields and Splunkbase ID are wrong.
findings.suggested_fix: Downgrade status until an S/4HANA controlling SME validates the SQL projections.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: `where tostring(VERSN) IN ("000","00","0")` and `where VERSN IN ("100",...,"104")` filter on a field that ACDOCA/ACDOCP do not have (ACDOCP uses `CATEGORY`), so unless the SQL fabricates `VERSN`, both legs return nothing.

The plan subsearch sums `budget_amount` across all of VERSN 100–104 (AOP plus four quarterly forecasts) into one budget, so budget is roughly 5× the real plan whenever several versions exist. Select a single comparison version, e.g. via a macro/token.

In the universal journal, revenue is posted as credits (negative HSL). With `account_type="REV" AND variance_lc<0` flagged unfavourable, higher revenue (more negative actual) is treated as unfavourable. Check the sign convention and flip the revenue logic (or multiply REV by -1 first).
`materiality_floor_usd` is compared with `HSL`, which is in company-code (local) currency, so the floors are wrong for non-USD entities. Use `KSL` (group currency) or convert.

summary: The variance logic and close-cycle troubleshooting are strong, but the UC is built on SAP fields that do not exist in S/4HANA. ACDOCA and ACDOCP carry no `VERSN`, and ACDOCP uses plan `CATEGORY` instead. The cited 'Splunk Add-on for SAP HANA' Splunkbase ID points to an unrelated app, and the search sums every plan version into one budget figure.
